source.text: አሌ፡ ለክሙ፡ ለሰማዕተ፡ ሐሰት፡ ወለእለ፡ ይደልውዎ፡ ለዐመፃ፡ እስመ፡ ፍጡነ፡ ትትሐጐሉ።
source.note: Own source-first corrective-author selected-body proposal. Printed stars retained; superscripts excluded. No alternate edition substituted. Separate peer and release gates remain.

translation.text: Woe to you, false witnesses, and to those who favor injustice, for you will quickly perish.[a]

footnotes.text: The source addresses false witnesses and those who favor injustice. Actual1865 cols336–339 supports witness language and93–94 falsehood;1078–1080 distinguishes basic/derived ranges of the favor/support verb. Favoring injustice is not replaced by an invented judicial office. Cols958 and1385–1386 supports injustice and quickly. The destruction/perishing root at18–19 distinguishes perish/be destroyed from its causative. Actual1907 grammar152–153,194 and204 supports the reflexive-passive plural; no named destroyer or date is supplied.

why_withdrawn: The favor relation was not established from the selected finite form, suffix and preposition. Broad derived lexical availability is insufficient. No preferred alternative English is certified.
